summary: Verified 3 acceptance goals: (1) PREDICTIONS HONESTY — 13/13 pytest passing in test_predictions_and_isolation.py; No-mileage/no-history returns every item with urgency in {unknown, inspect, test}, source=UNAVAILABLE, remainingLifePct=null, remainingKm=null, dueMileage=null, confidence=null. Response body has mileage=null AND mileageKnown=false. Brakes hardcoded to inspect, battery hardcoded to test (both UNAVAILABLE) regardless of mileage. After PATCH mileage=95000 the 8 interval items flip to source=MANUFACTURER_INTERVAL with numeric remainingLifePct (0–1) and confidence=0.55; brakes/battery remain inspect/test UNAVAILABLE. After POST /vehicles/{id}/history/maintenance (oil at 80000km) the OIL item promotes to source=USER_SERVICE_HISTORY with lastServiceKm=80000 and confidence=0.85 while brakes/battery are unaffected. (2) BACKEND USER ISOLATION — User B (fresh account) cannot see User A's vehicle in GET /vehicles (list excludes it), GET /vehicles/{A_id} returns 404, GET /vehicles/{A_id}/predictions returns 404 (vehicle-scoped 404 == access denied), PATCH /vehicles/{A_id} 404, /scans and /reports do not leak A's rows (filtered by user_id). User A still sees own data. Anonymous requests to /vehicles and /vehicles/{id}/predictions return 401/403. (3) FRONTEND LOGOUT + CACHE ISOLATION — Playwright (viewport 390x844): Guest -> tabs load -> Garage 'logout-button' visible -> tap logout -> returns to /auth with 'auth-guest-button' visible -> browser back button STAYS on /auth (the (tabs)/_layout.tsx Redirect to /auth when user==null is authoritative). Register new user -> land in tabs -> seeded window.localStorage keys ['veh_intel:predictions:testv1', 'veh:testv1:mileage', 'scan:testv1:last'] -> tap Logout -> ALL veh_intel:/veh:/scan: keys cleared AND jarvis_token=null. Continue-as-Guest afterwards -> localStorage still empty for those namespaces (no cross-user leakage). (4) PREDICTIONS UI — Promoted user to Pro; the /predictions?id=<vid> screen renders 10 cards each with testID=pred-source-<key> showing 'Source: ...'. With no mileage: every source row reads 'No verifiable data source', Battery card shows 'TEST REQUIRED'+'Physical test recommended', Brake Pads shows 'INSPECT'+'Physical inspection required', interval items show 'UNKNOWN'+'Insufficient data to determine status'. NO '% life left' bar anywhere. After mileage=95000, 8 interval items show 'Source: Manufacturer interval (recommendation)' + numeric '% life left' bar + '55% confidence'. Brakes/Battery remain 'No verifiable data source'. (5) NO REGRESSION — Guest dashboard after logout shows live gauges (RPM 2147, SPEED 99 km/h, COOLANT 87°C, BATTERY 13.8V etc.) — SimulationProvider still active on web preview. Login/Register/Guest flows all functional. Only console noise: React Native web deprecation warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents (cosmetic, non-blocking).
action_items: None for this master fix — all 3 acceptance goals (predictions honesty, backend isolation, logout+guest cache isolation) verified.

Nit (non-blocking, unrelated): React Native Web deprecation warnings for 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — surface only in console; recommend a future pass to migrate to 'boxShadow' and 'style.pointerEvents'.

Carry-over from previous iterations: server.py is ~1884 lines — splitting into routers (auth/vehicles/predictions/ai/subscription/shop) is still recommended. tests/test_diagnostics.py TestScansCreate remains failing by design (POST /scans returns empty ai_report) — ignore per main-agent note.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _compute_predictions correctly encodes the honesty contract: DIRECT_INSPECT={'brakes'} and TEST_ONLY={'battery'} short-circuit BEFORE any interval math, forcing UNAVAILABLE unless real evidence (min_voltage<12.2V for battery) exists. The 'not has_record and not has_mileage and not evidence -> unknown/UNAVAILABLE' branch is placed BEFORE the interval computation, so no fabricated % ever leaks (server.py:1200-1214).

vehicle_predictions dependency uses get_current_user -> per-user gather_vehicle -> 404 on miss (server.py:1367-1372). Since _gather_vehicle filters by user_id at the Mongo layer, User B looking up A's vehicle_id gets veh=None -> HTTPException 404 — correct tenant boundary with no data leak.

auth.tsx: logout() correctly (a) secureRemove(TOKEN_KEY), (b) removeItem(GUEST_KEY), (c) clearLocalUserData() which fires cacheClear() (veh_intel:) + licenseCache.clear() + storage.clearNamespace('veh:') + storage.clearNamespace('scan:'), (d) setUser(null). loginAsGuest() and persist() both call clearLocalUserData() FIRST so a new session never inherits prior state.

(tabs)/_layout.tsx authoritative auth guard: `if (!loading && !user) return <Redirect href='/auth' />;` unmounts the tab stack the moment user==null — this is why the browser Back button after logout does not navigate back into authenticated screens.

predictions.tsx renders `testID=pred-source-<key>` on every card and only renders the % bar+life text when `measurable = remainingLifePct != null && remainingKm != null` — matching the backend contract 1:1. No fake percentages under any state.
predictionsService.ts SOURCE_META maps UNAVAILABLE -> 'No verifiable data source' — this is what the user sees for brakes/battery/no-data cards. Correct.
storage.clearNamespace iterates AsyncStorage.getAllKeys and multiRemove — the correct primitive for namespace-scoped cache eviction (index.ts:102-110).

predictions endpoint is Pro-gated on the client via useEntitlement('predictive_maintenance') -> PremiumGate; this is UI gating only. The BACKEND endpoint is not entitlement-gated (a Free user could still call it directly). That's fine for honesty (data would still be UNAVAILABLE without mileage) but worth noting for future monetization enforcement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (guest+user logout, back-guard, cache isolation across all 3 namespaces, predictions UI honesty rendering in both no-mileage and 95k-mileage states)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users registered via POST /api/auth/register with password Jarvis2026! and emails 'test_<uuid>@example.com'. Vehicles created via POST /api/vehicles with {name,make='Honda',model='Civic',year=2018}. Mileage set via PATCH /api/vehicles/{id}. Service history logged via POST /api/vehicles/{id}/history/maintenance {title:'Oil change', meta:{mileage:80000}}. Pro tier set via POST /api/subscription/developer/set {action:'pro'}. NOTE for future agents: POST /api/scans REQUIRES 'workflow' field; email domain '.test' is REJECTED by Pydantic EmailStr — must use example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_predictions_and_isolation.py for predictions/isolation regressions. Payload requirements: POST /api/vehicles needs name+make+model+year; POST /api/scans needs workflow; register emails must NOT use .test (reserved) — use @example.com. Frontend: token stored under localStorage['jarvis_token'] JSON-encoded (strip quotes when injecting into fetch headers). Predictive Maintenance is Pro-gated in UI (useEntitlement); to view the real UI promote user via /api/subscription/developer/set {action:'pro'} then reload. Cache namespaces cleared on auth transitions: veh_intel:, veh:, scan: (plus licenseCache). Web preview uses SimulationProvider — do NOT expect real BLE; live gauges (RPM/SPEED/COOLANT/BATTERY) are simulated by design and are the CORRECT behavior.
